## Definition
A methodology for implementing efficient graph search algorithms on massively parallel neuromorphic hardware, addressing scalability bottlenecks. Bridges graph-based computation (TCC) with spiking neural substrates (iNEST), enabling large-scale network analysis in low-power, event-driven architectures.
